page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is an accelerated compute instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, 32.0 GB of system memory, and a dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and includes no local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring reliance on external block storage and associated networking configurations.

Benchmark results highlight the legacy nature of the underlying processor architecture. In synthetic CPU tests, the instance recorded a stress-ng single-core score of 953.38 (bottom 10%) and a multi-core score of 4755.08 (bottom 25%). Its PassMark CPU overall score reached 6698.53, placing in the average tier, although extended instruction performance (4265.68), encryption (2024.54), and physics tests (818.97) registered in the lower quartile. Memory throughput reflects similar constraints, with uncached large-block reads achieving 37.18 GB/sec and writes reaching 25.34 GB/sec, corresponding to a weak PassMark memory score of 1780.34.

Data processing and transactional throughput reflect lower-tier performance relative to contemporary hardware. The server scored 21.47 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 30.66 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Operational benchmarks logged 2252.2 on PassMark database operations, 5.48 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks, and 6.06 GB/sec for static web serving. While lacking modern AVX-512 and AMX instructions, it includes baseline AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA extensions.

The hardware configuration provides entry-level GPU offloading capability where high compute throughput is not strictly mandated. Lacking bundled local storage and high network bandwidth, it functions primarily as an economical option for small-scale GPU acceleration, lightweight machine learning inference, video transcoding pipelines, and visual computing tasks that leverage the Pascal architecture without demanding heavy general-purpose CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor (x86_64) running at 2.5 GHz with 8 vCPUs (4 physical cores) and 32.0 GB of RAM. Accelerated compute is supplied by a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. Networking operates at a baseline of 2 Gbps, and no local disk storage is included. Benchmark figures reflect the aging host platform, exhibiting low relative scores in stress-ng (953.38 single-core, 4755.08 multi-core) and memory throughput (37.18 GB/sec uncached reads), paired with a moderate 6698.53 PassMark CPU score. Lacking local disks and advanced vector instruction sets like AVX-512, this server represents an entry-level tier appropriate for lightweight GPU inference, basic visual computing, and video encoding workflows.
